key_idea: Count interior cells that are '0' with all eight neighbours equal to 'O'.
sketch: Loop over cells not on the border, check the 8 neighbours, count matches and remember the last one. Print the 1-based position if exactly one, 'Oh no!' if none, 'Oh no! N locations' if several. O(rc). Pitfall: digit zero versus letter O, and border cells can never qualify.
